name: Noltia
source:
Noltia contains three scenarios, which are not related to each other story-wise.

1. The first one can be played as either of its two main characters - the boy Aruto or the girl Kyoko. Both are not what they seem to be: Aruto is working for a registry organization in the World of the Dead, and he has to bring Kyoko to judgment, where it will be decided whether she goes to heaven or hell after death. However, Kyoko is actually an angel, whose goal is to save Aruto from killing himself. Both characters have special bars - the well-being of the protagonist and the proximity of the opponent to the protagonist's goal. Command choices can increase or decrease either of these statistics. Wrong choices can lead to Game Over.

2. The second scenario casts the player in the role of a high-school student named Yoshihiko, who is hired by a gym teacher to take erotic pictures of high-school girls and bring them to him. This scenario allows movement through school locations (menu command "Move"), and, depending on the player's choices, Yoshihiko can succeed in taking the most erotically satisfying pictures, or achieve one of the "bad" endings.

3. The third scenario is a realistic depiction of a relationship between a young man named Eiji and his little sister Miwa. The player can choose to play as either one of them. Eiji is dating Miwa's schoolmate, and Miwa tries to understand the change in her own feelings. In this episode, the gameplay is rather straight-forward Japanese adventure.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/noltia]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Noltia》包含三个剧情互不相关的篇章。

（1）第一篇可以选择两名主角之一进行游戏：少年阿尔特或少女恭子。两人都不像表面看起来那么简单。阿尔特供职于死者世界的户籍机构，必须把恭子带去接受审判，裁定她死后究竟该上天堂还是下地狱。然而，恭子其实是一名天使，她的目的是阻止阿尔特自杀。两名角色各有两项数值：一项代表主人公的状态，另一项表示对手距离主人公目标还有多远。选择指令会令其中一项数值上升或下降，错误的选择则可能导致游戏结束。

（2）第二篇中，玩家扮演高中生义彦。一名体育教师雇他偷拍女高中生的色情照片，再把照片交给自己。本篇可以通过菜单中的“移动”指令前往校内各处。根据玩家的选择，义彦既可能成功拍到最能满足委托人欲望的照片，也可能迎来某个坏结局。

（3）第三篇较为写实地描绘青年英治与妹妹美和之间的关系，玩家可以选择扮演其中任意一人。英治正在和美和的同学交往，美和则试图理解自己心中逐渐发生的变化。这一篇采用较为传统、直接的日式冒险游戏玩法。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/noltia]Moby Games[/url]]
